name: sensorpro
description: Work with SensorPro, the EU email marketing platform: look up and update contacts, find your most engaged subscribers, build campaigns with your own HTML designs and segments, send approved test and live broadcasts, and report on campaign results.

SENSORPRO_API_KEY.title: SensorPro API key
SENSORPRO_API_KEY.description: Secret. In SensorPro open API > API keys and copy the key named "Sensorpro rest API default key". If the key has an IP whitelist, the machine running the MCP server must be on it.

SENSORPRO_ORG.title: SensorPro organization
SENSORPRO_ORG.description: Your SensorPro organization name, exactly as you enter it on the SensorPro sign-in page.

SENSORPRO_USER.title: SensorPro API user
SENSORPRO_USER.description: Username of a SensorPro API user. API users are separate from normal SensorPro login users, and a normal login cannot use the API. Ask your SensorPro admin or support@sensorpro.net for an API user if you do not have one.

SENSORPRO_PASSWORD.title: SensorPro API user password
SENSORPRO_PASSWORD.description: Secret. Password of the API user above. SensorPro locks the account after 3 failed sign-ins, so double-check it before saving.
